description: Parent-round closeout go/no-go matrix schema. Defines gates, metadata, evidence requirements, idempotency, and GitHub 403 rollback/no-op behavior for automatic parent-round closeout. Source-only/no-live; never executes production auto-closeout.

gates.title: All lanes terminal
gates.failedWhenMissing: One or more child lanes are still in queued, claimed, or running state.
evidence: Lane status overview shows each lane as PR/Done/Block/Cancelled.
parentRoundProgress >= parentRoundTotal.
No lane in queued/claimed/running state; no stuck lanes.

gates.title: Lane evidence completeness
gates.failedWhenMissing: One or more terminal lanes are missing evidence URL, terminal summary, or required projection fields.
evidence: Every terminal lane has terminalEvidenceUrl (PR/Done/Block URL or valid evidence reference).
Every projection includes all required fields: projectionKey, terminalKind, terminalSummary, redacted, isApproval=false, isTerminalAck=false, isReadReceipt=false.
No lane has an empty/null evidence field.

gates.title: Required metadata present
gates.failedWhenMissing: Required metadata field is missing or invalid.
evidence: parentRoundId is set and non-empty.
parentRoundTotal is a positive integer.
parentRoundOrder is a positive integer ≤ parentRoundTotal.
parentRoundProgress is an integer ≤ parentRoundTotal.
originBrokerId, brokerOfRecordId, parentBrokerId are set and non-empty.
No metadata field contains placeholder or empty values.

gates.title: Evidence redaction check
gates.blockedWhenMissing: Terminal evidence contains unredacted secrets, runtime/bootstrap files, provider IDs, host-private paths, or raw session dumps.
evidence: All lane terminal evidence has been scanned for unredacted secrets (token shapes, private SSH keys, AWS keys).
No provider identifiers, chat IDs, or raw session content pasted in evidence.
No host-specific home-directory paths in evidence.
Runtime/bootstrap deny paths are absent from all evidence.

gates.title: OpenClaw runtime/bootstrap hygiene
gates.blockedWhenMissing: Runtime/bootstrap context files would enter branch diff, PR text, issue comment, or artifact evidence.
evidence: Branch diff excludes all denyPaths.
Artifact and PR/issue evidence exclude all denyPaths and raw runtime/session context.
Block output reports exact repo-relative offending paths when detected.

gates.title: No live action leak
gates.failedWhenMissing: One or more lane evidence entries show liveProviderSend: true, terminalOutboxAckMutated: true, isApproval: true, isTerminalAck: true, or isReadReceipt: true.
evidence: All lane evidence records show liveProviderSend: false, terminalOutboxAckMutated: false.
All lane evidence records show isApproval: false, isTerminalAck: false, isReadReceipt: false.
No evidence contains references to production deploys, restarts, or DB mutations.

gates.title: GitHub permission check
gates.blockedWhenMissing: GitHub API returned 403 on comment post or issue close attempt.
evidence: Preflight GitHub permission check passes: token has issue:write and issues:write scopes.
Repository is not archived.
No 403 errors from GitHub API during preflight check.
If 403 detected, rollback is metadata-only and operatorActionRequired is true.

gates.title: Idempotency check
gates.blockedWhenMissing: Conflicting idempotency key: same key but different payload detected. Requires operator review.
evidence: Derived idempotency key is unique for this parentRoundId.
No prior closeout record with the same key exists, OR existing record has identical payload.
If duplicate exists with identical payload, duplicateSuppressed: true.
If conflict (same key, different payload), conflictDetected: true and operatorActionRequired: true.

gates.title: Seoseo finalizer check
gates.failedWhenMissing: The broker attempting closeout is not Seoseo. Only Seoseo may close the parent issue.
evidence: The evaluating broker matches the designated finalizer (Seoseo).
Non-Seoseo evaluation is informational only and does not produce a closeout action.
Seoseo operator identity is confirmed before closeout execution.

gates.title: Cross-lane projection status
gates.blockedWhenMissing: One or more lane parent projections have state blocked.
evidence: All lane parent projections have state projected or done.
No lane projection has state pending or conflict.
If any projection is blocked, the blocker reason is documented for operator review.
If any projection is pending, the round is NO_GO (not BLOCKED).

gates.title: Comment-only approval gate
gates.blockedWhenMissing: comment_only mode selected but comment body is empty, contains unapproved content, or idempotency check fails.
gates.failedWhenMissing: comment_only mode requires a non-empty draft comment body; dry-run or simulate mode does not produce a closeout comment.
evidence: Mode is comment_only and a non-empty draft comment body is produced.
Draft comment is human-readable before posting (operator may preview).
GitHub permission check passes before comment attempt.
Idempotency key prevents duplicate comment posting.
Close/merge/ACK/replay/DB mutation/restart/deploy remain disabled; comment_only posts a comment only, not a close decision.

a2a-plane-nosuk.role: Parent-round closeout go/no-go matrix spec/runbook and validation fixture
